description:
Hushfeed v0.26.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

New here: the feed can fade out over the last three quarters of a minute of a time budget, so the hold is somewhere you arrive rather than somewhere you land. Two switches for a feed that plays when nobody is watching it: one quietens it while the comments are open, the other holds it after you come back to the app until you tap once. Both are off unless you turn them on.

The settings screen speaks Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese as well as German and Indonesian, and it speaks them everywhere. The hand-built dialogs, the Feature Gate Lab, the diagnostics picker, the line behind every setting that asks for a restart: all of it was English whatever your phone was set to, and there is now a check that fails the build when a sentence reaches a view without going through the table.

Fixed here: the mirrored layouts were never actually mirrored. The payload had not declared right-to-left support, so every mirrored screenshot and every mirrored test was laid out left to right and the back arrow pointed the wrong way. The little counts on the settings menu now count the page rather than a list kept beside it, which had drifted to seventeen of thirty-four settings on one page and counted defaults as things you had turned on. A caption view that this build has under a different name is reported instead of leaving both caption settings quietly doing nothing.

Faster here: working out which day it is no longer copies the device timezone on every frame the player reports. It listens for the timezone changing instead.

Also here: seven patches were renamed to match the setting they add, so a patch applied by name can be found by that name. If you had Hide content warnings, Fit video to the screen, Uncap the refresh rate, Enable non-personalized search, Enable Live search, Show seekbar or Show seekbar thumbnail selected, select them again.

Validation: 819 runtime tests passed locally, plus twelve in the patches module. The bundle carries 70 patches, passed checks for all three DEX payloads, and applied cleanly to the vendor APK. It is byte reproducible: two builds of this commit produce the same file. Needs Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
